steps: Sign up free at freecash.com via email, Google, Facebook, or Steam.
Open the game offer wall and choose a game offer (examples on the official page: Monopoly Go! at $215, Uno at $10).
Before starting, read the milestones and requirements listed on that offer — it pays only when those milestones are reached.
Download the game and play until you hit each milestone.
Withdraw to PayPal, Venmo, bank, crypto, or gift cards; note the cashout fee (official example: $5 → $4.75 received) and that crypto typically processes within 24 hours.
timing: Crypto withdrawals typically process within 24 hours. PayPal/Venmo/bank and gift-card withdrawals per the official cashout page; a fee applies (5% in the official example).
